gsod<N>: Daily weather observations by station and date; one row per station-day (stn, wban, year, mo, da) with measures: temp, count_temp, dewp, count_dewp, slp, count_slp, stp, count_stp, visib, count_visib, wdsp, count_wdsp, mxpsd, gust, max, flag_max, min, flag_min, prcp, flag_prcp, sndp, fog, rain_drizzle, snow_ice_pellets, hail, thunder, tornado_funnel_cloud.
stations: Weather station metadata; one row per station identifier (usaf, wban) with attributes: name, country, state, call, lat, lon, elev, begin, end.
storms_<N>: Storm event records; one row per storm event (episode_id, event_id) with location/time and impacts: state, state_fips_code, event_type, cz_type, cz_fips_code, cz_name, wfo, event_begin_time, event_timezone, event_end_time, injuries_direct, injuries_indirect, deaths_direct, deaths_indirect, damage_property, damage_crops, source, magnitude, magnitude_type, flood_cause, tor_f_scale, tor_length, tor_width, tor_other_wfo, location_index, event_range, event_azimuth, reference_location, event_latitude, event_longitude, event_point.
wind_reports: Point wind report observations; one row per report (timestamp) with time, speed, location, county, state, latitude, longitude, comments, report_point.
tornado_paths: Tornado path geometries and summary attributes; one row per tornado path (storm_date, storm_time) with time_zone_offset, state_abbreviation, state_name, state_fips_code, magnitude, injured_count, fatality_count, property_loss, crop_loss, yearly_tornado_count, start_lon, start_lat, end_long, end_lat, length, width, tornado_path_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER.
tornado_reports: Individual tornado reports; one row per report (timestamp) with time, f_scale, location, county, state, latitude, longitude, comments, report_point.
hail_reports: Individual hail reports; one row per report (timestamp) with time, size, location, county, state, latitude, longitude, comments, report_point.
nws_forecast_regions: NWS forecast region definitions; one row per region/zone (state, cwa, time_zone, fe_area, zone) with name, state_zone, lon, lat, shortname, shape_geometry.
hurricanes: Hurricane/advisory track points; one row per track observation (sid, season, number) with basin, subbasin, name, iso_time, nature, latitude, longitude, wmo_wind, wmo_pressure, wmo_agency, track_type, dist2land, landfall, iflag, usa_agency, usa_latitude, usa_longitude, usa_record, usa_status, usa_wind, usa_pressure, usa_sshs, usa_r34_ne, usa_r34_se, usa_r34_sw, usa_r34_nw, usa_r50_ne, usa_r50_se, usa_r50_sw, usa_r50_nw, usa_r64_ne, usa_r64_se, usa_r64_sw, usa_r64_nw, usa_poci, usa_roci, usa_rmw.
icoads_core_<N>: ICOADS ship/observation core records; one row per observation (year, month, day, hour, latitude, longitude) with metadata and measured variables: imma_version, attm_count, time_indicator, latlong_indicator, ship_course, ship_speed, national_source_indicator, id_indicator, callsign, country_code, wind_direction_indicator, wind_direction_true, wind_speed_indicator, wind_speed, visibility_indicator, visibility, present_weather, past_weather, sea_level_pressure, characteristic_of_ppp, amt_pressure_tend, indicator_for_temp, air_temperature, wbt_indicator, wetbulb_temperature, dpt_indicator, dewpoint_temperature, sst_measurement_method, sea_surface_temp, total_cloud_amount, lower_cloud_amount, low_cloud_type, cloud_height_indicator, cloud_height.
icoads_core_2001_<N>: ICOADS core subset for 2001; same grain as icoads_core_<N> (one row per observation year-month-day-hour-lat-lon) with columns: imma_version, attm_count, time_indicator, latlong_indicator, ship_course, ship_speed, national_source_indicator, id_indicator, callsign, country_code, wind_direction_indicator, wind_direction_true, wind_speed_indicator, wind_speed, visibility_indicator, visibility, present_weather, past_weather, sea_level_pressure, characteristic_of_ppp, amt_pressure_tend, indicator_for_temp, air_temperature, wbt_indicator, wetbulb_temperature, dpt_indicator, dewpoint_temperature, sst_measurement_method, sea_surface_temp, total_cloud_amount, lower_cloud_amount, low_cloud_type, cloud_height_indicator, cloud_height.
icoads_core_1662_<N>: ICOADS core subset (source 1662); one row per observation (year, month, day, hour, latitude, longitude) with the same measured fields as icoads_core_<N>: imma_version, attm_count, time_indicator, latlong_indicator, ship_course, ship_speed, national_source_indicator, id_indicator, callsign, country_code, wind_direction_indicator, wind_direction_true, wind_speed_indicator, wind_speed, visibility_indicator, visibility, present_weather, past_weather, sea_level_pressure, characteristic_of_ppp, amt_pressure_tend, indicator_for_temp, air_temperature, wbt_indicator, wetbulb_temperature, dpt_indicator, dewpoint_temperature, sst_measurement_method, sea_surface_temp, total_cloud_amount, lower_cloud_amount, low_cloud_type, cloud_height_indicator, cloud_height.
nrs_metadata: Holds file-level metadata for NRS acoustic files; grain = one row per file (file_name); notable keys/measures = file_name, deployment_name, start_date, start_time, source_organization, funding_organization, project_name, sensor_depth, sample_rate, duration, platform_name, lon, lat, point_geom, file_link
sanctsound_metadata: Holds file-level metadata for SanctSound acoustic recordings; grain = one row per file (file_name); notable keys/measures = file_name, data_collection_name, start_date, start_time, source_organization, funding_organization, project_name, sensor_depth, sample_rate, recording_percent, platform_name, longitude, latitude, file_link
ncei_nrs_pad_metadata: Holds NCEI PAD-style metadata for NRS files; grain = one row per file (file_name); notable keys/measures = file_name, deployment_name, start_date, start_time, source_organization, funding_organization, project_name, sensor_depth, sample_rate_hz, recording, platform_name, lon, lat
ncei_nefsc_pad_metadata: Holds NCEI PAD metadata ingested from NEFSC for multiple-shape files; grain = one row per file (file_name, cloud_path); notable keys/measures = cloud_path, file_name, start_date, start_time, data_collection_name, source_organization, funding_organization, project_name, sensor_depth, sample_rate, duration, platform_name, shape1, shape2, shape3, shape4, shape5, shape6, shape7, shape8, shape9, shape10
ncei_afsc_pad_metadata: Holds NCEI PAD metadata ingested from AFSC; grain = one row per file (file_name, cloud_path); notable keys/measures = cloud_path, file_name, start_date, start_time, data_collection_name, source_organization, funding_organization, project_name, sensor_depth, sample_rate, duration, platform_name, shape
ncei_sanctsound_pad_metadata: Holds NCEI PAD-style metadata for SanctSound files; grain = one row per file (file_name); notable keys/measures = file_name, data_collection_name, start_date, start_time, source_organization, funding_organization, project_name, sensor_depth, sample_rate_hz, recording, platform_name, lon, lat
dclde_2020_1705_visual_sightings: Records visual marine mammal sightings from DCLDE 2020-1705 cruise; grain = one row per sighting (sighting_number); notable keys/measures = local_ship_date, sighting_local_time, sighting_number, species_id, effort, effort_type, latitude, longitude, point, bearing, distance, total_best, total_high, total_low
dclde_2020_detection_readme: Provides field-level descriptions for DCLDE detection tables; grain = one row per documented field (table, field); notable keys/measures = table, field, description
dclde_2020_1705_minke_detections: Records detected minke whale acoustic events for DCLDE 2020-1705; grain = one row per detection event; notable keys/measures = detection_time_start_local, detection_time_start_utc, detection_time_end_utc, latitude, longitude, point
dclde_2020_1705_array: Provides array-level timing and hydrophone measurements for DCLDE 2020-1705; grain = one row per array deployment/time window; notable keys/measures = array_start_local, array_end_local, array_start_utc, array_end_utc, array1, array2, hp1_dist, hp1_ad, hp2_dist, hp2_ad, hp3_dist, hp3_ad, hp4_dist, hp4_ad, hp5_dist, hp5_ad, hp6_dist, hp6_ad
dclde_sette_array_depth: Time-series of array inline and end depths for the Sette array; grain = one row per timestamp; notable keys/measures = utc_time, local_time, inline_depth, end_depth
dclde_lasker_array_depth: Time-series of array inline and end depths for the Lasker array (partitioned); grain = one row per timestamp (PARTITION may indicate partition key); notable keys/measures = utc_time, local_time, inline_depth, end_depth, PARTITION
dclde_2020_species_lookup: Holds species reference data; grain = one row per species; keys/measures = code, common_name, species_name.
dclde_2020_1706_odontocete_detections: Holds odontocete acoustic detection events; grain = one row per acoustic detection (acoustic_detection_number); keys/measures = detection_time_start_local, detection_time_start_utc, detection_time_end_utc, acoustic_detection_number, sighting_number, latitude, longitude, point, first_angle, first_distance, beam_distance, beam_time_utc, detection_distance, species1_id, species2_id, species3_id.
dclde_2020_1706_array: Holds array deployment/observation summary per deployment interval; grain = one row per array time interval (array_start_local/array_start_utc to array_end_local/array_end_utc); keys/measures = array_start_local, array_end_local, array_start_utc, array_end_utc, array1, array2, hp1_dist, hp1_ad, hp2_dist, hp2_ad, hp3_dist, hp3_ad, hp4_dist, hp4_ad, hp5_dist, hp5_ad, hp6_dist, hp6_ad.
dclde_sette_gps: Holds GPS trackpoints from Sette vessel; grain = one row per GPS fix (utc_time); keys/measures = utc_time, local_time, latitude, longitude, point, speed, effort.
dclde_lasker_gps: Holds GPS trackpoints from Lasker vessel; grain = one row per GPS fix (utc_time); keys/measures = utc_time, local_time, latitude, longitude, speed, effort.
dclde_2020_1706_visual_sightings: Holds visual marine mammal sighting records for 1706 survey; grain = one row per sighting (sighting_number); keys/measures = local_ship_date, sighting_local_time, sighting_number, species_id, effort, effort_type, latitude, longitude, point, bearing, distance, total_best, total_high, total_low.
dclde_2020_1705_odontocete_detections: Holds odontocete acoustic detection events for 1705 survey; grain = one row per acoustic detection (acoustic_detection_number); keys/measures = detection_time_start_local, detection_time_start_utc, detection_time_end_utc, acoustic_detection_number, sighting_number, latitude, longitude, point, first_angle, first_distance, beam_distance, beam_time_utc, detection_distance, species1_id, species2_id, species3_id.
earthquakes: Holds earthquake events and damage metrics; grain = one row per earthquake (id); keys/measures = id, flag_tsunami, year, month, day, hour, minute, second, focal_depth, eq_primary, eq_mag_mw, eq_mag_ms, eq_mag_mb, eq_mag_ml, eq_mag_mfa, eq_mag_unk, intensity, country, state, location_name, latitude, longitude, region_code, deaths, deaths_description, missing, missing_description, injuries, injuries_description, damage_millions_dollars, damage_description, houses_destroyed, houses_destroyed_description, houses_damaged, houses_damaged_description, total_deaths, total_deaths_description, total_missing, total_missing_description, total_injuries.
historical_runups: Holds historical tsunami runup/observation records tied to source events; grain = one row per runup observation (id); keys/measures = id, tsevent_id, year, month, day, timestamp, doubtful, country, state, location_name, latitude, longitude, region_code, distance_from_source, arr_day, arr_hour, arr_min, travel_time_hours, travel_time_minutes, water_ht, horizontal_inundation, type_measurement_id, period, first_motion, deaths, deaths_description, injuries, injuries_description, damage_millions_dollars, damage_description, houses_damaged, houses_damaged_description, houses_destroyed, houses_destroyed_description.
historical_source_event: Holds historical source events (tsunami/earthquake sources); grain = one row per source event (id); keys/measures = id, year, month, day, timestamp, event_validity, cause_code, focal_depth, primary_magnitude, country, state, location_name, latitude, longitude, region_code, maximum_water_height, abe, iida, soloviev, warning_status, deaths, deaths_description, missing, missing_description, injuries, injuries_description, damage_millions_dollars, damage_description, houses_destroyed, houses_destroyed_description, houses_damaged, houses_damaged_description, total_deaths, total_deaths_description, total_missing, total_missing_description, total_injuries, total_injuries_description, total_damage_in_millions_dollars, total_damage_description.
